newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PARIS ST GERMAIN TITLE HOPES DISAPPEAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PARIS ST GERMAIN TITLE HOPES DISAPPEAR.

text.p: Paris St Germain appeared to have blown their last chance of catching runaway French league leaders Monaco with a lame 1-1 home draw with Rennes on Saturday.
Monaco beat Lille 2-0 on Friday and are now 12 points ahead of second-placed PSG with just six matches left.
The Parisians, in shock after the news that goalkeeper Bernard Lama had failed a dope test for cannabis, stayed firmly in second spot as their main rivals were unable to win.
Strasbourg lost in Nancy 2-0 while Nantes, unbeaten in their last 25 matches, drew 1-1 with Marseille and lie third. Nantes and Strasbourg are on 53 points, two behind Paris St Germain.
PSG had to come from behind as Rennes opened the scoring with a Stephane Guivarch penalty after 37 minutes. Substitute Cyrille Pouget equalised 18 minutes from time.
